introduction: Tennessee WIC enrollment begins with your local health department. Use the state clinic directory or WICShopper’s Find a WIC Clinic option.
description: Tennessee WIC enrollment begins with your local health department. Use the state clinic directory or WICShopper’s Find a WIC Clinic option.

sections.who: The clinic assesses the qualifying pregnancy or young-child category, income and nutrition needs.
sections.get: Approved food and nutrition services include breastfeeding support.
sections.docs:
• Identification and address evidence requested by the clinic.
  • Household income or benefit records.
  • Health and child information for the appointment.
sections.apply:
1. Contact local WIC intake

    Use the state WIC Clinics directory.

  2. Arrange the appointment

    Ask who must attend and which records are needed.

  3. Complete enrollment

    Discuss nutrition needs and learn the food and shopping instructions.
sections.after: Keep follow-up appointments. Tell the clinic about access or language needs; the state provides free assistance on request.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using Tennessee WIC clinic intake and participant help. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: The state directs applications to local clinics and identifies that number for concerns or certification-transfer requests.
